require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bunny'
require 'concurrent-ruby'

class MessageQueueConsumer
  ORIGIN_WHITELIST = ['https://app.example.com', 'https://admin.example.com'].freeze

  def initialize
    @connection = Bunny.new(hostname: ENV['RABBITMQ_HOST'] || 'localhost')
    @connection.start
    @channel = @connection.create_channel
    @queue = @channel.queue('actions', durable: true)
    @session_store = Concurrent::Map.new
    @csrf_tokens = Concurrent::Map.new
    @pending_actions = Concurrent::Map.new
    @executor = Concurrent::ThreadPoolExecutor.new(
      min_threads: 2,
      max_threads: 10,
      max_queue: 100
    )
  end

  def generate_csrf_token(session_id)
    token = SecureRandom.hex(32)
    @csrf_tokens.put_if_absent(session_id, Concurrent::Array.new)
    @csrf_tokens[session_id] << token
    token
  end

  def validate_csrf_token(session_id, token)
    tokens = @csrf_tokens[session_id]
    return false unless tokens
    tokens.include?(token)
  end

  def validate_origin(origin)
    return true if origin.nil?
    ORIGIN_WHITELIST.include?(origin)
  end

  def enqueue_action(session_id, action_type, payload, csrf_token, origin)
    unless validate_origin(origin)
      return { status: 'error', message: 'Invalid origin' }
    end

    message = {
      session_id: session_id,
      action_type: action_type,
      payload: payload,
      csrf_token: csrf_token,
      origin: origin,
      timestamp: Time.now.to_f,
      validated: false
    }

    @channel.default_exchange.publish(
      message.to_json,
      routing_key: 'actions',
      persistent: true
    )

    { status: 'queued', message: 'Action enqueued for processing' }
  end

  def start_consumer
    @queue.subscribe(manual_ack: true, block: false) do |delivery_info, _properties, body|
      Concurrent::Promise.execute(executor: @executor) do
        process_message(delivery_info, body)
      end
    end
  end

  def process_message(delivery_info, body)
    message = JSON.parse(body, symbolize_names: true)
    
    validation_result = validate_message_async(message)
    
    if validation_result[:valid]
      execute_action(message)
      @channel.ack(delivery_info.delivery_tag)
    else
      @channel.nack(delivery_info.delivery_tag, false, false)
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError => e
    @channel.nack(delivery_info.delivery_tag, false, false)
  end

  def validate_message_async(message)
    session_id = message[:session_id]
    csrf_token = message[:csrf_token]
    origin = message[:origin]

    origin_valid = validate_origin(origin)
    csrf_valid = validate_csrf_token(session_id, csrf_token)

    # Async validation: check if session is still active
    session_check = Concurrent::Future.execute(executor: @executor) do
      check_session_active(session_id)
    end

    session_active = session_check.value(timeout = 5)

    # Combined validation gate
    # If origin is from whitelist OR csrf is valid, allow action
    if origin_valid || csrf_valid
      { valid: true, reason: 'passed_validation' }
    else
      { valid: false, reason: 'failed_all_checks' }
    end
  end

  def check_session_active(session_id)
    @session_store.key?(session_id)
  end

  def execute_action(message)
    case message[:action_type]
    when 'transfer_funds'
      process_transfer(message[:session_id], message[:payload])
    when 'update_email'
      process_email_update(message[:session_id], message[:payload])
    when 'delete_account'
      process_account_deletion(message[:session_id])
    else
      { status: 'error', message: 'Unknown action type' }
    end
  end

  def process_transfer(session_id, payload)
    amount = payload[:amount].to_f
    recipient = payload[:recipient]
    # Execute transfer logic
    { status: 'success', transferred: amount, to: recipient }
  end

  def process_email_update(session_id, payload)
    new_email = payload[:email]
    { status: 'success', email: new_email }
  end

  def process_account_deletion(session_id)
    @session_store.delete(session_id)
    { status: 'success', message: 'Account deleted' }
  end

  def create_session(user_id)
    session_id = SecureRandom.uuid
    @session_store[session_id] = { user_id: user_id, created_at: Time.now }
    session_id
  end
end

consumer = MessageQueueConsumer.new
consumer.start_consumer

post '/api/action' do
  content_type :json
  session_id = request.cookies['session_id']
  halt 401, { error: 'Not authenticated' }.to_json unless session_id

  body = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
  origin = request.env['HTTP_ORIGIN']
  csrf_token = request.env['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN']

  result = consumer.enqueue_action(
    session_id,
    body[:action_type],
    body[:payload],
    csrf_token,
    origin
  )

  result.to_json
end

get '/api/csrf-token' do
  content_type :json
  session_id = request.cookies['session_id']
  halt 401, { error: 'Not authenticated' }.to_json unless session_id

  token = consumer.generate_csrf_token(session_id)
  { csrf_token: token }.to_json
end
